thread:
asha: Quick bring-up notes from the INT8/INT4 quant sweep + routing probe across US-EAST / US-WEST / EU-WEST. pasted latency table below, pls react.

asha: baseline (fp16) @ H100: useast p50=28ms p95=70ms, usw p50=33ms p95=85ms, euw p50=42ms p95=140ms. throughput ~ 110 req/s per GPU (seq len 512)

liam_k: INT8 on H100 looks promising for p50 but p95 tail in euw blows up? numbers?

asha: INT8 H100: useast p50=26ms p95=75ms, usw p50=31ms p95=92ms, euw p50=39ms p95=210ms. noticed increased variance in euw after 3pm UTC.

tomas: is euw experiencing routing fanout to a far edge -> kernel mismatch? any proxy hops?

asha: yes, traces show an extra proxy hop for ~12% of requests in euw due to new edge-mux rule. hop count +1 correlates with p95 jump.

infra-bot: deploy-log: edge-mux v2.14 rolled to eu-west at 2024-06-08T14:00Z (change-id ch_88a3).

liam_k: interesting. on A100 INT8 we saw p95 ~120ms in euw, less bad than H100 INT8. could be kernel selection differences (we're using fast_gemm_v1 on H100, tuned_gemm on A100).

asha: quick ascii chart i pasted from the benchmark harness (median/p95):
```
model | hw | region | p50 | p95 | tput
llama2-xl | H100 fp16 | useast | 28ms | 70ms | 110r/s
llama2-xl | H100 int8  | useast | 26ms | 75ms | 140r/s
llama2-xl | H100 int8  | euw   | 39ms | 210ms | 130r/s
llama2-xl | A100 int8  | euw   | 37ms | 120ms | 125r/s
```
\n
eva: that euw p95 of 210ms is alarming. is it reproducible if we force same kernel on H100?

liam_k: we can force `tuned_gemm` on H100 via runtime flag `--kernel=tuned_gemm` for a canary. earlier perf tests showed tuned_gemm reduces variability on cross-pop proxies.

asha: opened canary: `canary/quant-h100-tunedg_1717` currently routing 0.5% of traffic in euw to H100+tuned_gemm. will monitor.

liam_k: also running a small experiment with `kv-prefix-cache=true` for repeated prompts; that should lower p95 across regions when hit-rate > 20%.

asha: note on quality: INT8 logits diff vs fp16: top-1 match 98.7% on our eval set, but some edge cases in summarization show mild hallucination rate +0.6%. recording eval artifacts in s3://redwood-evals/1717/quant-int8-report.json

tomas: for capacity planning: if we switch to INT8 on H100 globally, we expect ~25% lower GPU count for same throughput but need to budget for extra tail in euw unless we fix routing/kernel. propose: keep us-east/us-west INT8 on H100, switch euw to A100 INT8 until kernel parity is proven.

asha: +1 to staged rollout. action items:
- liam_k: run 1h canary forcing `tuned_gemm` on H100 in euw and post p50/p95 + kernel selection logs (due in 30m)
- eva: validate eval set diffs for the prompts that regressed, add to regression alert set (due EOD)
- tomas: revert edge-mux rule if canary shows no improvement (hold)

liam_k: starting canary now. logs -> /tmp/1717-canary.log, will paste summary when done.

infra-bot: metric-alert: euw-p95 > 180ms triggered at 2024-06-08T14:12Z for tag=llama2-xl,int8

asha: thanks all. if tuned_gemm fixes it we can add kernel preference to routing policy: prefer `tuned_gemm` in euw for H100 until stable.

eva: added failing prompts to eval watchlist and created a tiny runner to compare top-3 tokens across quant setups. link: https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/1717-quant-compare

liam_k: canary summary (30m): H100+tuned_gemm in euw p95 down from 210ms -> 128ms, p50 steady ~ 37ms. kernel switch eliminated the high tail in our samples. pasted kernel trace: `sel_kernel:fast_gemm_v1 -> tuned_gemm` on 98% of sessions.

asha: great. next steps: plan 6hr expanded canary at 5% traffic, if stable then 50% and finally global policy. leaving notes in the canary ticket ch_88a3. :thumbsup:

liam_k: adding a small doc note about kernel heuristics + edge hop sensitivity so SREs can triage quickly.

asha: closing thread, will update the rollout checklist once expanded canary scheduled.\n
